notes.title: Early review published!
notes.content:
[p]Hi. This is KITTYPOOL.[/p][p][/p][p]It has been one month since the start of the crowdfunding.
Thanks to all of your support, the progress has reached 16%.
I am truly grateful from the bottom of my heart.[/p][p]Today, I have an astonishing super-wow surprise news to share with you.[/p][p][/p][h1]Early review published by Ginga Kondo![/h1][p][/p][p]Ginga Kondo, known as an artist, art historian, and author of "Feminist, Playing Games" (Shobunsha, 2024), has played the full version of our work ahead of release!
We have received her early review.[/p][p][/p][h2][url="https://kitty-pool.com/shoestringsstory/en.html#review" style="button"]You can read the full review here.[/url][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45347625/45521536e0f357d3be3c8e2bc2df34bcb3b53abe.png"][/img][/p][p]As "Shoestrings Story" is a visual novel game, it is difficult to convey its fun before release.[/p][p]Of course, I could go around saying "This is what it’s about! It’s fun!" but a self-promotion from the creator, like saying "My curry is the best," has its limits in credibility.[/p][p][/p][h3]"So then, why not let a third party play it?"[/h3][p][/p][p]Thus, this crowdfunding, which was actually launched over a year ago, has finally been made public. Thank you. Thank you. Ah, excuse me, the applause… I’m sorry, thank you very much.[/p][p][/p][p]Now, with this, all the promotion plans for this work have come to an end.[/p][p]In the remaining month, I will continue doing my best to promote so that the crowdfunding can reach its goal.[/p][p]
I would be very happy if you could also support us by spreading the word or mentioning it on social media.[/p][p]Since this afterword has become rather long, let me repeat once more...[/p][p][/p][h1][url="https://kitty-pool.com/shoestringsstory/en.html#review"]You can read the wonderful full review by Ginga Kondo here![/url][/h1]

notes.title: Look! A Crowdfunding Campaign!
notes.content:
[p]To begin with...[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]Shoestrings Story (Japanese version) is finally complete!![/h1][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45347625/ec03d5659fb10b8b7092e936e9355b19029d25aa.gif"][/img]
[/p][p]We started conceptualizing the game in 2021, finished the story and character designs, and began full-scale development in 2024. After countless sleepless nights and a development period that spanned roughly a year and a half, the visual novel “Shoestrings Story” is finally complete.

Thanks to your support, we were able to stay motivated throughout the process.

We sincerely appreciate your continued encouragement.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p] And now...[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]The crowdfunding campaign has begun![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45347625/ec03d5659fb10b8b7092e936e9355b19029d25aa.gif"][/img]

Although the Japanese version is complete, the game contains over 200,000 characters including system messages, making the translation extremely costly.

I don’t expect many people to read this post, so I’ll be honest: I have a wife and a 3-year-old daughter. Both of us work, and my annual income is under 2.5 million yen.

We do have savings, but they’re reserved for my daughter’s future, and I want to avoid using them if at all possible.

On top of that, I have a rare disease designated by the government. However, due to a disturbing legal revision about five years ago, the designation has essentially lost all meaning, and I now receive no medical assistance from the government (To anyone wondering “Even though it’s a rare disease?”—yes, exactly).

Because of this, I’ve had to change jobs repeatedly, and it looks like I’ll be leaving my current position next month. These aren’t career-advancing moves—my income keeps dropping.

In short... I have no financial wiggle room!

Realistically, I could earn more if I spent my time doing a regular job. But I’ve continued making games because all the skills I’ve developed since childhood are rooted in subculture, and game development is what I’m best at.

Am I planning to quit game development if this doesn’t sell? I’m not sure. But I’m also open to exploring new paths and testing my potential elsewhere.

What’s my point? Just this—I am seriously in need of support!

A few days have passed since the campaign launched, and already 7 people have backed the project, bringing us to 9% of our goal. I was worried it might stay at 0%, so I’m incredibly grateful. Thank you so much.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p] Now, let me explain the key feature of the crowdfunding platform we’re using KICKSTARTER.....[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]If the goal is not met, all funds are returned to the backers. I won’t receive a single yen![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45347625/c222f2cff64b08b8cfc247546803d1871b1ed726.png"][/img]

There are two types of crowdfunding models:[/p][list][*][p]All-or-Nothing: If the goal isn't reached, the funds aren't collected, and the project doesn’t need to be completed.[/p][/*][*][p]All-In: Funds are collected even if the goal isn't reached, and the project must be completed.[/p][/*][/list][p]KICKSTARTER only supports the All-or-Nothing model.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]

Now you understand, right?[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45347625/ec03d5659fb10b8b7092e936e9355b19029d25aa.gif"][/img]
[/p][p]The crowdfunding page is here! Your warm support would mean the world to me: [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/kittypool/localize-shoestrings-story-into-english-and-chinese/"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/kittypool/localize-shoestrings-story-into-english-and-chinese/[/url][/p]

notes.title: Demo Now Supports Simplified Chinese!
notes.content:
[p]The demo now supports Simplified Chinese![/p][p]However, please note that the title displayed on the Steam store is still in Japanese as "くつひも物語".
We have already requested a title change from Valve, and once approved, the Steam store page in Simplified Chinese will display the title as "鞋带物语".[/p][p]Special thanks to [b]flankoi[/b] for translating the demo![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45347625/41c62722010fc9f20e9a6f8b21d8b758881609b3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Main Updates[/b][/h1][h2][b]Update Version 0.1.1[/b][/h2][olist][*][p]Fixed an issue where the text in the lockpicking mini-game used an incorrect font, causing tofu characters to appear[/p][/*][/olist][h2][b]Update Version 0.1.0[/b][/h2][olist][*][p]Added support for Simplified Chinese[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where keyboard input did not work on certain screens[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed a possible cause of Known Bug (1)[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bug fixes[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Shoestrings Story v0.0.13
notes.content:
Fixed: The game could fail to launch if save data from Ver 0.0.7 was still present when starting Ver 0.0.11.

Please note that this is an interim fix and the issue may still reoccur on certain systems. We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your continued support.

notes.title: Shoestrings Story ver0.0.11
notes.content:
We have replaced the previous build with the latest version (0.0.11).
All fixes are now in place. We apologize for the earlier error.

notes.title: 【くつひも物語】体験版をリリースしました！
notes.content:
The demo for Shoestrings Story is now live!
Play through the early part of the adventure—starting right after the opening chapter. (Approx. 1-hour playtime.)
Hope you enjoy it!
